title: Legacy redirect stubs honor BASE_PATH
description:
As the Anth.us site, I want to serve the leaderboard at https://anth.us/biased-decisions/ by building it with BASE_PATH=/biased-decisions/ and SITE_URL=https://anth.us, so the leaderboard lives on the main domain. Every page already honors BASE_PATH except the legacy redirect stubs from site/scripts/legacy-redirects.mjs, which point their refresh, link and canonical at the root ("/religion/" instead of "/biased-decisions/religion/"), sending 415 old addresses to 404s under a sub-path.

Feature: Legacy redirects under a sub-path
  Scenario: A redirect stub built with a base path points inside that base path
    Given the site is built with BASE_PATH "/biased-decisions/" and SITE_URL "https://anth.us"
    When a legacy redirect stub is written for "/religion/"
    Then its refresh target and link are "/biased-decisions/religion/"
    And its canonical is "https://anth.us/biased-decisions/religion/"
  Scenario: A root build is unchanged
    Given the site is built with no BASE_PATH
    When a legacy redirect stub is written for "/religion/"
    Then its refresh target is "/religion/"
